items.stem: Why is thermal control a critical spacecraft subsystem in the vacuum of space?

options.text: Without air, heat transfers mainly by radiation, so components can overheat or freeze
options.rationale: Correct: vacuum removes convection, so thermal design manages radiative balance.

options.text: Because space is uniformly room temperature
options.rationale: Space is not a uniform comfortable temperature.
Thermal control manages temperature, not thrust.

options.text: Because air conditioning is cheaper in space
options.rationale: There is no air to condition in vacuum.

items.explanation: Correct: vacuum removes convection, so thermal design manages radiative balance.

items.stem: Which TWO are reasons engineers keep margins in mass and power budgets? (Select TWO.)

options.text: To absorb growth and uncertainty as the design matures
options.rationale: Correct: margins cover inevitable design growth and uncertainty.

options.text: To reduce the risk of exceeding launch or power limits
options.rationale: Correct: margins protect against breaching hard limits.

options.text: To make the spacecraft deliberately heavier
options.rationale: Margins manage risk, not add weight for its own sake.

options.text: Because budgets are never checked again
options.rationale: Budgets are tracked throughout the program.

items.explanation: Correct: margins cover inevitable design growth and uncertainty.

items.stem: What is the main purpose of environmental testing before launch?

options.text: To show the spacecraft can survive launch and space conditions
options.rationale: Correct: testing verifies survival of vibration, vacuum and thermal extremes.

options.text: To make the project take longer on purpose
options.rationale: Testing reduces risk; delay is not its purpose.

options.text: To replace the need for any requirements
options.rationale: Testing verifies against requirements, not instead of them.

options.text: To paint the spacecraft for launch
options.rationale: That is unrelated to environmental testing.

items.explanation: Correct: testing verifies survival of vibration, vacuum and thermal extremes.
